llm_request:
请将以下英文文章翻译成中文：

A new model Tesla's surprising new route to EV domination Become more like the industry you disrupted

IN 2011 TESLA stated an aim of becoming "the most compelling car company of the 21st century, while accelerating the world's transition to electric vehicles". At the time this was easy to dismiss as crackers. In the eight years since its founding in 2003 the firm had manufactured a piddling 1,650 EVs. Its first big-selling car, the Model S, had yet to hit the road. Today it is almost as mad to argue that Elon Musk, the carmaker's boss since 2008, has not achieved that goal. His company, a rare insurgent in an industry with formidable barriers to entry, has grown at neck-snapping speed. In the first quarter of 2023 Tesla's Model Y mini-SUV was the world's bestselling car. In the second quarter it delivered a total of 466,000 cars, beating analysts' forecasts (see chart 1). Mr Musk's promise of 2m sales this year, up from 1.3m in 2022, no longer seems fanciful. On July 15th the first Cybertruck, an angular, retro-futuristic pickup, rolled off the production line. Tesla has just unveiled an expansion plan for its German factory, where it wants to double capacity to 1m vehicles per year.
llm_response:
以下是这段英文文章的中文翻译：

**特斯拉的新车型：令人惊讶的电动汽车霸业新路径——变得和你曾颠覆的行业越来越像**

2011年，特斯拉曾提出一个目标，要成为“21世纪最具吸引力的汽车公司，同时加速世界向电动汽车的转变”。在当时，人们很容易对这番豪言壮语一笑了之，认为简直是痴人说梦。自2003年成立以来的八年里，这家公司仅仅生产了少得可怜的1650辆电动汽车。其首款热销车型Model S当时甚至还未上路。

而到了今天，如果还有人认为自2008年起担任该公司掌门人的埃隆·马斯克没有实现这一目标，那几乎同样会被视为荒谬之谈。在一个有着极高进入壁垒的行业中，特斯拉作为罕见的“破局者”，以令人惊叹的速度崛起。2023年第一季度，特斯拉的Model Y迷你SUV成为全球最畅销的汽车。第二季度，其累计交付量达到46.6万辆，超出了分析师的预期（见图表1）。马斯克曾承诺今年销量要从2022年的130万辆提升至200万辆，如今看来这已不再是天方夜谭。7月15日，首辆Cybertruck——一款棱角分明、具有复古未来主义风格的皮卡——正式下线。此外，特斯拉刚刚公布了其德国工厂的扩建计划，目标是将该厂的年产能翻番，提升至100万辆。
